title: Professional Certificate Course in Employment Protection and Dismissal
description: To learn about the various types and reasons for dismissal, including fair and unfair dismissal, constructive dismissal, and wrongful dismissal.
longDescription: The concept of employment dismissal. The various types of dismissal. Various reasons for fair and unfair dismissal. Various signs of constructive dismissal. Various examples of wrongful dismissal. Steps for dismissing an employee. Through this course, you'll learn about the various types of dismissal, including fair and unfair dismissal, constructive dismissal, and wrongful dismissal. You'll discover the different reasons that may lead to fair or unfair dismissal and the signs of constructive dismissal that every employer should be aware of. Plus, you'll explore examples of wrongful dismissal and the potential consequences for employers. We'll also guide you through the necessary steps for dismissing an employee in a fair and legal manner. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
